description: Smart Playlist Manager: create app/playlist.py with classify_genre and assign_playlist, add list_playlists/create_playlist/add_to_playlist to app/youtube.py, add POST /api/video/{id}/playlist and POST /api/channel/{id}/playlists/sync endpoints to app/main.py, add Playlist button to web/library.html. Independent of FEAT-001 except it relies on the youtube_playlist_id column already added in FEAT-001 step 3.
steps: 1. Create app/playlist.py. Imports: json, logging; get_ai_connection from .database; get_youtube_service from .auth; list_playlists/create_playlist/add_to_playlist from .youtube. Define GENRE_KEYWORDS dict mapping genre name -> list of lowercase keyword strings: Horror->['horror','scary','dark','ghost','haunted','bhoot','dar'], Comedy->['comedy','funny','laugh','joke','prank','hilarious','hasna','mazak'], Roast->['roast','troll','exposed','savage'], Reaction->['reaction','react','reacting','response'], Music->['music','song','gana','rap','beat','melody','lyrics'], News->['news','breaking','report','update','viral','latest'], Education->['learn','education','tutorial','how to','explain','facts','sikh','sikhna'], Motivation->['motivation','inspire','success','mindset','hustle'], Drama->['drama','kahani','story','emotional','feel','relationship'], Action->['action','fight','battle','war','challenge'], Shorts->['shorts','short video','clip']. Default fallback genre is 'Story'. Define classify_genre(analysis_json): parse JSON safely (try/except returning {}), combine summary+style+title+tags fields into one lowercase text blob, iterate GENRE_KEYWORDS in priority order, return first genre whose any keyword is found as a substring, fall back to 'Story'. Define assign_playlist(channel_id, youtube_video_id, analysis_json, channel_name): 1) genre=classify_genre(analysis_json); 2) items=list_playlists(channel_id); 3) existing=next((x for x in items if str((x.get('snippet') or {}).get('title','')).startswith(genre)), None); 4) if existing: playlist_id=existing['id'], title=existing['snippet']['title'], created=False; else: resp=create_playlist(channel_id, f'{genre} — {channel_name}', f'Auto-created playlist for {genre} content.', 'public'); playlist_id=resp['id']; title=resp['snippet']['title']; created=True; 5) add_to_playlist(channel_id, playlist_id, youtube_video_id); 6) log.info('[PLAYLIST] genre=%s playlist_id=%s created=%s', genre, playlist_id, created); 7) return {'genre':genre,'playlist_id':playlist_id,'playlist_title':title,'created':created}.

2. In app/youtube.py, append three functions after extract_hash_marker: list_playlists(channel_id) using youtube.playlists().list(part='snippet,status', mine=True, maxResults=50) with pagination loop; create_playlist(channel_id, title, description, privacy='public') using youtube.playlists().insert(part='snippet,status', body={...}); add_to_playlist(channel_id, playlist_id, youtube_video_id) using youtube.playlistItems().insert(part='snippet', body={'snippet':{'playlistId':playlist_id,'resourceId':{'kind':'youtube#video','videoId':youtube_video_id}}}).

3. In app/main.py, add 'from .playlist import assign_playlist' and 'from .youtube import list_playlists as yt_list_playlists' to the imports block. Add two new endpoints at the bottom: POST /api/video/{video_id}/playlist (validates row exists and is uploaded, calls asyncio.to_thread(assign_playlist,...), calls update_video(video_id, youtube_playlist_id=result['playlist_id']), logs and returns {ok, genre, playlist_id, playlist_title, created}) and POST /api/channel/{channel_id}/playlists/sync (validates channel exists, calls asyncio.to_thread(yt_list_playlists, channel_id), returns {ok, playlists:[{playlist_id,title,privacy}], count}).

4. In web/library.html, inside the render() function's template literal for the Actions <td>, append after the Thumbnail button (added in FEAT-001): '${v.status==="uploaded"?`<button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="assignPlaylist(${v.id},\'${esc(v.filename)}\')">📂 Playlist</button>`:""}'. Add assignPlaylist(id, name) async JS function: calls POST /api/video/{id}/playlist, on success calls setMessage('body', msg, 'success') where msg describes which playlist was used/created, on error calls setMessage('body', e.message, 'error').
